Centred modal on a navy scrim with a 2px blur; 12px radius, elevation 3.

```jsx
<Dialog open={open} title="Withdraw this application?"
  description="It moves to Withdrawn. Nothing is deleted."
  onClose={close}
  footer={<><Button variant="ghost" onClick={close}>Cancel</Button><Button>Withdraw</Button></>} />
```

Positions against the nearest positioned ancestor, so mount it inside the screen frame in UI kits.
